_comment: Cast id -> Kokoro voice + age profile. pitch_st shifts pitch AND formants together (semitones): up reads younger, down reads older. speed multiplies the speaking rate. Edit freely, then run render_audio.py (only changed lines are re-synthesised).

c1.note: adult male, stern older man: lower and slower

c2.note: young adult male, dry and lazy: natural

c3.note: teen girl, bright and cheeky: higher and quicker (younger)

c4.note: young adult woman, cool and commanding: slightly lower, measured
